title: Reproducibility harness: renv + conda/pixi locks + Quarto dual-track render
context: Every lesson must execute reproducibly in both R and Python from pinned environments. This task builds the reproducibility harness - renv plus conda/pixi lockfiles and a Quarto dual-track render - that all modules and CI depend on.
objective: Deliver a reproducibility harness: renv.lock (R) and environment.yml/pixi.lock (Python) that build clean in a fresh runner, plus a Quarto dual-track example that renders deterministically from one source.
acceptanceCriteria: renv.lock (R) and environment.yml/pixi.lock (Python) build clean in a fresh runner.
Quarto renders a dual-track (R + Python) example from one source; outputs deterministic.
Documented minimum specs + a free cloud-notebook fallback path.
